column1: # Same compact 64 KiB preamble as the badge table so ota_0 starts at 0x10000
# but the app slots are 0x390000 instead of 0x380000: the esp32 build is about
# 65 KiB larger than the esp32s3 build and does not leave usable headroom in a
# 0x390000 is deliberate: it is the smallest slot that fits the esp32 image and
# keeps ota_1 at a 64 KiB-aligned offset (0x10000 + 0x390000 = 0x3a0000). App
# partition offsets must be 64 KiB aligned
